title: MGI MGIEasy Nucleic Acid Extraction Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: MGI MGIEasy Nucleic Acid Extraction Kit
Bead drying- pause to let beads air dry.

steps.title: Lysis and bead binding
steps.instruction: Mix the provided lysis buffer with the magnetic beads to suspend them, then dispense the mixture into the wells of a deep‑well plate (up to 96 throat swab or bronchoalveolar lavage samples) placed on the Magnetic Module using the MGI MGIEasy Nucleic Acid Extraction Kit.

steps.title: Collect beads and discard lysate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module to immobilize the beads, then transfer the supernatant from each well to the liquid waste reservoir.

steps.title: Wash beads (three cycles)
steps.instruction: Perform three wash cycles: for each cycle, transfer wash buffer from the reagent reservoir to the bead‑containing wells, mix to resuspend the beads, re‑engage the magnets, and discard the wash supernatant into the liquid waste reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: transfer wash buffer, mix, engage magnets, discard supernatant
Wash 2: transfer wash buffer, mix, engage magnets, discard supernatant
Wash 3: transfer wash buffer, mix, engage magnets, discard supernatant

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol to allow the beads to air‑dry on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Transfer elution buffer to the bead wells, mix to release nucleic acids, re‑engage the magnets, and move the eluate to an elution plate held at 4 °C on the Temperature Module.
